```yaml
name: Pre-Checkout Cleanup
run-name: Cleaning up workspace before checkout on self-hosted runner

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      cleanup_type:
        description: 'Type of cleanup to perform'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: 'standard'
      force_cleanup:
        description: 'Force cleanup even if workspace appears clean'
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  pre-checkout-cleanup:
    name: Pre-Checkout Cleanup
    runs-on: self-hosted
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - name: Setup Environment
        id: setup
        run: |
          echo "Setting up cleanup environment..."
          echo "WORKSPACE_PATH=${{ github.workspace }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "CLEANUP_TYPE=${{ inputs.cleanup_type }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "FORCE_CLEANUP=${{ inputs.force_cleanup }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          
      - name: Check Workspace Status
        id: workspace_check
        run: |
          echo "Checking workspace status..."
          WORKSPACE_SIZE=$(du -sh "${{ github.workspace }}" 2>/dev/null | cut -f1)
          FILE_COUNT=$(find "${{ github.workspace }}" -type f 2>/dev/null | wc -l)
          echo "Workspace size: $WORKSPACE_SIZE"
          echo "Files in workspace: $FILE_COUNT"
          echo "WORKSPACE_STATUS=checked" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          
      - name: Cleanup Python Cache Files
        if: always()
        run: |
          echo "Removing Python cache files..."
          find "${{ github.workspace }}" -type d -name "__pycache__" -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null || true
          find "${{ github.workspace }}" -type f -name "*.pyc" -delete 2>/dev/null || true
          find "${{ github.workspace }}" -type d -name ".pytest_cache" -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null || true
          find "${{ github.workspace }}" -type d -name ".coverage" -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null || true
          echo "Python cache cleanup completed"
          
      - name: Cleanup Build Artifacts
        if: always()
        run: |
          echo "Removing build artifacts..."
          find "${{ github.workspace }}" -type d -name "build" -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null || true
          find "${{ github.workspace }}" -type d -name "dist" -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null || true
          find "${{ github.workspace }}" -type d -name "*.egg-info" -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null || true
          find "${{ github.workspace }}" -type f -name "MANIFEST" -delete 2>/dev/null || true
          echo "Build artifact cleanup completed"
          
      - name: Cleanup Temporary Files
        if: always()
        run: |
          echo "Removing temporary files..."
          find "${{ github.workspace }}" -type f -name "*.tmp" -delete 2>/dev/null || true
          find "${{ github.workspace }}" -type f -name "*.temp" -delete 2>/dev/null || true
          find "${{ github.workspace }}" -type f -name "*~" -delete 2>/dev/null || true
          find "${{ github.workspace }}" -type f -name ".DS_Store" -delete 2>/dev/null || true
          echo "Temporary file cleanup completed"
          
      - name: Cleanup Log Files
        if: always()
        run: |
          echo "Removing log files..."
          find "${{ github.workspace }}" -type f -name "*.log" -delete 2>/dev/null || true
          find "${{ github.workspace }}" -type f -name "debug.log" -delete 2>/dev/null || true
          find "${{ github.workspace }}" -type f -name "error.log" -delete 2>/dev/null || true
          echo "Log file cleanup completed"
          
      - name: Verify Cleanup
        if: always()
        run: |
          echo "Verifying cleanup completion..."
          FINAL_FILE_COUNT=$(find "${{ github.workspace }}" -type f 2>/dev/null | wc -l)
          echo "Final file count after cleanup: $FINAL_FILE_COUNT"
          echo "Cleanup verification completed"
          
      - name: Report Cleanup Status
        if: always()
        run: |
          echo "## Cleanup Summary" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "| Item | Status |" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "|------|--------|" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "| Workspace Path | ${{ github.workspace }} |" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "| Cleanup Type | ${{ inputs.cleanup_type }} |" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "| Force Cleanup | ${{ inputs.force_cleanup }} |" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "| Files Before | N/A |" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "| Files After | $FINAL_FILE_COUNT |" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "Cleanup process completed successfully." >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
```
